name: Translator and interpreter

pf.license.business: No trade license for translation or interpreting. Business registration where the state's form asks for it; identity checked; 'license: what the business says'.
pf.license.person: No person license. Certificates the owner adds, kept as given with their date and renew-by (S2-29, not checked), limit what each person is offered: court interpreting only by a court-certified or court-registered interpreter where the court's rules require it; medical interpreting only by a certified medical interpreter where the clinic or the state's rules require it; a notarized translation only by a notary with a current commission.
pf.license.claims: 'Certified translation' means the translator's signed statement that it's accurate, never a license claim.

pf.services.name: On-site interpreting
pf.services.example: $75 an hour, 2-hour minimum ($150) (the example agency's own price)
pf.services.length: 2 hours or more, billed by the half hour after the minimum
pf.services.where: B: the customer's appointment (a clinic, a lawyer's office, a school meeting, a business meeting, a wedding)
pf.services.money: B: a card saved for the late-cancel fee; billed after for the time used

pf.services.name: Video interpreting
pf.services.money: A: a card saved; the saved card is charged at DONE for the time used

pf.services.name: Certified document translation
pf.services.example: $45 a page for a birth certificate or a diploma, priced from photos of the pages
pf.services.length: brought to the office once for the original to be seen; the certified translation is ready in 3 business days
pf.services.money: A: the full price when booking, once the photo price is OK'd

pf.questions.before_times: The language pair; the kind of appointment in general words only (medical, legal or court, school, business, personal), since it sets who may go (a certificate) and how long; the date, start time and expected length; for documents, how many pages and the date they're needed by (a need-by date).
pf.questions.after_time: Name and mobile of the person booking; for on-site work, the address and who the interpreter meets there (a front desk, a clinician, the person served).
pf.questions.secure_page_only: The person served's name and any details of the case, the health visit or the legal matter; the documents themselves (photos of pages); a preference for a woman or a man interpreter, where the plug-in allows it (A4-16).
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult for themselves; an organization (a clinic, a law office, a school, a court, a company) for the person it serves; a parent for a child's documents. A teen can't book alone.

pf.safety.stop_words: A medical emergency or danger described in the request (an interpreter is no emergency service).
pf.safety.what_rosie_says: 'If anyone is in danger, call 911 now. 911 can connect an interpreter.' No booking during an emergency.

pf.first_steps.required: Documents: photos of every page before the price (the photo quote). Court and medical work: the interpreter's certificate on file before they're offered.
pf.first_steps.prep: On-site: the interpreter arrives 15 minutes early and checks in at the front desk. Documents: bring the original.

pf.visit.B: The interpreter checks in with the code given by the person they meet (the booker, the clinic's front desk or the person served); the session runs; time past the booked length is an extra the customer OKs first; DONE with the time used.
pf.visit.A: Video: most sessions join the customer's own meeting (a clinic's telehealth room, a company's video call, a remote hearing), so the customer gives that meeting link for the interpreter; otherwise the interpreter's own link. The code is read out at the start. Documents: the original is seen at the office, the code given there; the certified translation is ready later, on the secure page, with a printed copy to pick up where asked.
pf.visit.done_proof: DONE from the interpreter (B, video); the code at the office (documents).

pf.money.ways: On-site: a card saved, billed after for the time used. Video: a card saved, charged at DONE. Documents: the full price when booking.
pf.money.fees: On-site: the 2-hour minimum ($150) inside 48 hours or nobody there. Video: the 1-hour minimum inside 24 hours. Documents: none once work started (a cancel in time gets everything back).
pf.money.accounts: Clinics and law offices that book often get one bill a month (the owner's setting).
pf.money.rosfield: $2 per booking (not a health practice or a law firm).

pf.messages.never_in_text: What the appointment is about (a diagnosis, a court case, an immigration matter), the person served's name for an organization's booking, and anything in the documents. Texts say only 'your interpreting visit' or 'your translation'.
pf.messages.languages: The business's language pairs (example: Spanish, Vietnamese and Arabic with English). Texts go in the customer's language where Rosie can use it; a person follows up otherwise.

pf.staff.skills: Each person's language pairs and certificates (court, medical); only people whose pairs and certificates fit are offered.
pf.staff.named: A booking that names an interpreter, or asks for a woman or a man interpreter, is never moved to someone else on silence.
pf.staff.alone: Interpreters work alone on site: an emergency contact is required for the check-out timer.

pf.rules.confidentiality: Every assignment is confidential (the interpreter's code of ethics); nothing about it is shared beyond the people on the booking.
pf.rules.certified: A certified translation carries the translator's signed statement of accuracy; a notarized one only a commissioned notary signs.
pf.rules.court: Court interpreting only where the court's own rules let a private booking supply the interpreter; otherwise the court assigns its own.

pf.edges.an organization books for a patient or c: the organization is the customer; the person served gives their own private answers (B4-107)
pf.edges.the session runs over: more time is an extra the customer OKs first (B8-23)
pf.edges.the person served needs a woman or a man: A4-16, where the plug-in allows it
pf.edges.a translation late: staff text LATE with a new date (A10-29)

A.other: Others (a clinic, a court, a parent)
